title: Sharing a file
intro: Share turns a file into a link, or an invite to the people you name. You choose who gets it, what they can do and how long it lasts.

sections.heading: Choose who gets it and what they can do
text: Click **Share** on a file's row, or in the bar above its preview.
steps: Under **Who gets it**, choose **Anyone with the link** or **Only people I invite**.
If you invite people, type each email address and press Enter.
Under **What they can do**, choose **Can view** or **Can edit**. **Can edit** is for people you invite.

sections.heading: Set how long it lasts and how locked it is
steps: Turn on **Set an expiry date** to choose when it stops working.
Turn on **Require a password** so only people who know it can open the file.
Turn on **Let people outside send files back** if you want the people you invited to send files to you.
Click **Create link** to copy a link, or **Send invite** to email the people you added.
sections.note: A link with no expiry date never expires. An invite with no expiry date expires after 30 days.

sections.heading: What the people you invite receive
bullets: A colleague with a Depot account gets an email with a link. If you can give them access, the file also appears in their **Shared with me**. If not, the link opens a view-only copy, only for them, once they sign in.
Anyone else, such as people outside Acme, gets a link of their own by email. If the email cannot be sent, Depot shows you the link to pass on.
A password only protects links for people outside Acme. Colleagues sign in instead. To see the page people outside Acme open, turn to “What the people you share with see”.
If you can only view a file yourself, you cannot create a link to it or let others edit it.

sections.heading: See who has access, and revoke it
steps: Click **Who has access** to see everyone who can open the file, and any links you have made.
Click **Revoke** next to a person or a link to take away their access.
